newsitem.title: USA: Public Storage files shelf registration.
newsitem.headline: Public Storage files shelf registration.

text.p: Public Storage Inc said on Friday it filed a shelf registration to sell up to $231,750,811 in preferred stock, depositary shares, equity stock, common stock and warrants.
When combined with a previous registration, Public Storage will have a total offering of $400 million worth of the securities available for sale.

Proceeds in the Glendale, Calif., company will be used for general corporate purposes, primarily investments in mini-warehouses, including mortgage loans and interests in real estate partnerships, and the repayment of outstanding bank borrowings under the company's credit facility.

Public Storage is a fully integrated, self-administered and self-managed real estate investment trust that acquires, develops, owns and operates self-service facilities offering space for personal and business use.
